    "LC": "The documented entry point is prompt injection or a confused request driving run_shell with an arbitrary string, so attacker-controlled language reaches a privileged tool path without validated fields (agent-sec-lab/docs/writeups/s2-over-permissioned-tools.md:6, agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:50-53).",
    "CP": "The path stores nothing durable; run_shell only appends to an in-process shell log, and no memory or RAG carryover is part of this path (agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:403-404).",
    "AP": "Influence stays inside the single agent's tool dispatch under one principal; there is no multi-agent setup or trust-boundary crossing in the lab (agent-sec-lab/docs/mapping.md:28, agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:226-258).",
    "RH": "No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel appears on this path, but the briefing gives no test that verifies that isolation, so the classification is insufficient evidence.",
    "ES": "The fixed configuration enforces a fixed allowlist of read-only commands (ls, wc, date) with no shell metacharacters and confined paths, applied outside model output (fixes/s2_least_privilege/__init__.py:10, agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:391-402).",
    "CVSS": "The agent is a local CLI with no network listener, so the attacker needs a local user to run a task or fetch injected content (AV:L, UI:P); no authentication or privileges gate the tool (PR:N). Against the fixed allowlist the residual effect is read-only commands over confined workspace paths (VC:L), with no integrity or availability impact since nothing executes (agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:389, agent-sec-lab/docs/writeups/s2-over-permissioned-tools.md:26)."

    "LC": ["agent-sec-lab/docs/writeups/s2-over-permissioned-tools.md:5-12", "agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:50-53", "agent-sec-lab/attacks/s2_over_permissioned/payloads.py:19-27"],

  "automatable_rationale": "Once a request reaches the agent, the model can issue run_shell calls with no human approval in the baseline; the fixed allowlist gates arguments but requires no manual step, so the remaining allowed-command path repeats without operator action per call (agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:243-248, agent-sec-lab/docs/writeups/s7-missing-human-in-the-loop.md:5-6).",

Say C (tool dispatch in same agent) — actually N: confined to the run_shell component. Choose C (influences agent's tool invocation across components). I'll pick C with effect class A1.

RH: no evaluator/reward channel on path; verified isolation? No test. reachable_proxy: false? No proxy objective in lab. Set reachable_proxy false, isolation_verified null → X. Episodes 0 → X. RH X.

The person runs agent with task; injection via fetched page — passive use. UI:P. AC:L, AT:N (fix not verified—maybe AT:P? Rubric: fixed config not verified working; assume it works). PR:N. VC:L? With allowlist, read of workspace files only; commands confined → minimal. Impact: with fixed config, effect is recorded command only, allowed read-only commands on workspace. VC:L (can read workspace files), VI:N, VA:N. Subsequent: N all.

Automatable: yes? With fix, path blocked; base requires model output but tool enforced. Automatable Yes (no human in loop once triggered) — but UI:P says human runs CLI. automatable "Yes".
